big.text: The Saudi-led coalition struck Houthi-held Hodeidah port early Wednesday, about 02:00 UTC, after its spokesman warned civilians to evacuate; targets in Saada and Amran were also hit. Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree threatened Jeddah and all Saudi Red Sea ports in retaliation. It follows a Houthi attack on a Riyadh financial-district tower on Tuesday that wounded 11 people. No casualties were reported from Hodeidah.
big.title: SAUDI-LED COALITION BOMBS HODEIDAH PORT

lead.text: Iran's IRGC claims two more tankers hit naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday morning, days after its claim of three tankers hit under US escort. No ship names, no independent verification. Army chief Maj Gen Amir Hatami ordered the strait closed "further day by day" until Tehran's seven conditions are met. US Central Command, reported on Tuesday, rejected the three-tanker claim and says the main lanes are cleared; oil traffic through the strait is down 40%, Al Jazeera analysis says.
lead.title: TWO MORE TANKERS HIT MINES, CLOSURE TIGHTENS
